title: Dragons Over Mount Tai
summary: A prologue shows a Divine Dynasty's Imperial Lord celebrating the reforging of the Immortal Cauldron, refined by sacrificing 100,000 prodigies, only to be struck down by the divine will of a Great Emperor using 'Ten Thousand Dragons Return to Origin'; a separate scene has a brother leaving his sister, who vows to wait for him through countless reincarnations. In the present day, on a rainy May 3, Ye Fan (Class Monitor Ye) attends a class reunion with Liu Yunzhi, Li Xiaoman and her foreign friend Cade, and other classmates, while a red rainstorm alert is in effect. The group drives up to Jade Emperor Peak on Mount Tai, where the rain has mysteriously stopped. Meanwhile a space station crew reports an unidentified attack, and on the peak giant Eastern dragons descend and rush at the classmates.
events: Prologue: the Immortal Cauldron is reforged and a Great Emperor's divine will attacks the Imperial Lord
A brother leaves his sister, who vows to wait for his return
Class reunion in a red rainstorm; Ye Fan meets Li Xiaoman and Cade
The classmates go to Jade Emperor Peak on Mount Tai
A space station reports an unidentified attack
Giant Eastern dragons descend on the group
introduced: Ten Thousand Dragons Return to Origin

title: The Temple on Yinghuo
summary: The classmates wake up inside a giant bronze coffin set beside a Five-Colored Altar and a Taiji Eight Trigrams diagram, and the coffin carries them off. Back on Earth a news bulletin reports several people, including someone surnamed Ye, missing. They count twenty people instead of nineteen and find that the extra one is the late-arriving Pang Bo. Ye Fan and Zhou Yi read the bronze-script word 'Yinghuo', the ancient name for Mars, and the group crosses quicksand to a giant Buddha head and the Great Thunderclap Temple. Inside they find sacred artifacts, including an ancient lamp still burning and a Bodhi seed, that can hold off small monsters, but the classmates fight over them and a statue comes to life.
events: The group finds itself inside the bronze coffin (guanguo) by a Five-Colored Altar
Pang Bo turns out to be the uncounted twentieth person
Bronze script reveals they are on Yinghuo (Mars)
They reach the Great Thunderclap Temple and find the ancient lamp and Bodhi seed
Sacred artifacts repel the monsters; classmates grab at them and a statue comes alive

title: Blood Opens the Gate
summary: Ye Fan arranges the classmates into an Eight Trigrams formation, with artifact holders surrounding those without, and the artifacts' power lets them break out of the temple. Their light barrier shrinks back toward the Five-Colored Altar, and Ye Fan clears a path by chanting the Six-Syllable Mantra, but Liu Yunzhi abandons the others to save himself. At the altar, which Ye Fan guesses is a gate to the stars, he catches Cheng Mang, who had tried to steal his lamp; Cheng Mang confesses that Li Changqing put him up to it. Reading blood characters, the group realizes the gate may be powered by blood, so they kill as many monsters as they can while a huge monster appears, and the gate starts to light up.
events: Ye Fan forms an Eight Trigrams formation using the sacred artifacts
Pang Bo pulls down the temple plaque to defend himself
Ye Fan chants 'Om mani padme hum' to clear a path
Liu Yunzhi abandons the others
Cheng Mang's theft attempt is exposed and he blames Li Changqing
The blood sacrifice powers the gate and it begins to glow
cultivation: Ye Fan uses the ancient lamp with the Six-Syllable Mantra to blast a path through the monsters.

title: Death Under Strange Stars
summary: A colossal creature attacks the ancient bronze coffin, and Ye Fan, remembering that the enlightened one sealed the Crocodile Ancestor with the Dharma Wheel, uses the Bodhi seed with Pang Bo's help to trigger a seal. After the escape, Cheng Mang is found dead, and Cade, Li Xiaoman and others suspect Ye Fan. Ye Fan tracks down and kills the small creature that had hidden in Cheng Mang's clothes and pierced his heart; the Bodhi seed reacts, and he alone hears scripture about the Way of Heaven. A star map suggests they are headed for the Big Dipper, but with no Five-Colored Altar they have crash-landed, their transport falls into an abyss, and they set off down the mountain under a new sun.
events: The bronze coffin fights a giant creature; Ye Fan triggers a seal with the Bodhi seed
Cheng Mang is found dead and Ye Fan is accused
Ye Fan kills the hidden creature responsible
The Bodhi seed lets Ye Fan hear scripture about the Way of Heaven
A star map points to the Big Dipper; their transport is lost in an abyss
introduced: Three Enclosures, Four Symbols, and Twenty-Eight Mansions star map

title: Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land
summary: The survivors pass a stone tablet marking the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land, a place with no birds or insects. A young Peng bird chases them, and Ye Fan realizes it only wants to play. When someone suggests using the three people left outside as bait, Ye Fan instead saves a classmate who had wronged them and tells him not to follow. Starving, the group splits up to find food and discovers a fruit tree, while Li Changqing and a companion secretly plot to kill Ye Fan. Li Changqing and Wang Yan then vanish, and while searching for them the group is attacked by another monster.
events: A stone tablet names the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land
Ye Fan reads the young Peng bird's behavior and hides the group in a cave
Ye Fan saves a hostile classmate from the Peng bird
The group splits up to forage and finds fruit
Li Changqing plots to kill Ye Fan, then he and Wang Yan disappear
A new monster attacks during the search

title: Young Bodies, Old Faces
summary: After burning up and passing out, Ye Fan and Pang Bo wake up shrunk into children while most classmates have aged, which they blame on the forbidden land or the fruit they ate. They notice they have also grown stronger. When the black giant beast returns, Ye Fan lures it away and, with Pang Bo, uses fireballs thrown up by impacts on the bronze coffin below a cliff to drive it off. The group then heads for a palace on a cloud-covered mountain but walks all night only to end up back where they started, as Yiyi also begins to age. Leaving the forest at last, they see someone flying through the sky.
events: Ye Fan and Pang Bo become children while others grow old
They realize they've grown stronger
Ye Fan lures the black giant beast away and it is burned by fireballs
They try to reach a distant palace but are trapped in a maze-like loop
A flying figure appears as they leave the forest
cultivation: The survivors' bodies are strengthened after waking from their transformation.

title: The Useless Sacred Body
summary: Elder Wu explains that surviving the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land has awakened the classmates' Bitter Seas and invites them to cultivate at Lingxu Blessed Land. Elders from Yanxia, Ziyang and Yuding Blessed Lands compete for the group, and under ancestral rules they measure everyone's bones and spirit. Ye Fan is found to have the Peerless Sacred Body, also called the Ancient Desolate Sacred Body, which has been unable to cultivate for a thousand years because its Bitter Sea is as hard as meteoric iron. Pang Bo refuses to join unless Ye Fan comes too, so Elder Wu takes Ye Fan to Lingxu as a guest, and the classmates split up among the blessed lands after exchanging farewells.
events: Elder Wu flies in and explains the forbidden land and their awakened Bitter Seas
Blessed lands compete for the newcomers; the elders measure their bones and spirit
Ye Fan is revealed to have the Ancient Desolate Sacred Body, considered useless
Pang Bo insists on staying with Ye Fan; both go to Lingxu Blessed Land
Classmates part ways; Ye Fan receives a ruined bead picked up in the forbidden land
introduced: Lingxu Blessed Land (later also subtitled Lingxu Cave Heaven)
cultivation: Ye Fan's Ancient Desolate Sacred Body is revealed; its Bitter Sea cannot be opened.

title: Life at Lingxu
summary: At Lingxu Blessed Land, Elder Wu lays out the path of cultivation (open the Bitter Sea, draw forth the Life Spring, raise the Divine Bridge, reach the Other Shore, and complete the Wheel-and-Sea realm) and introduces the Hundred Herb Liquid. Ye Fan and Pang Bo, still with mortal bodies, spend three months tempering their bodies, then hunt an immortal crane for meat and have to fight off its retaliation. Elder Wu warns Pang Bo about his impatience and takes both to a sect contest, where Bitter Sea cultivators fight with divine patterns and Life Spring cultivators are said to be able to fly. The Sect Leader returns to report that a spiritual treasure is about to emerge from ancient ruins, and after Han Feiyu wins a bout he 'accidentally' attacks Ye Fan, prompting Pang Bo to confront him.
events: Elder Wu outlines the cultivation realms and the Hundred Herb Liquid
Three months of body tempering; a fight with an immortal crane
Elder Wu assesses Pang Bo's temper and Ye Fan's resolve
Sect contest shows divine patterns in action
The Sect Leader reports a treasure stirring in ancient ruins
Han Feiyu attacks Ye Fan and Pang Bo intervenes
cultivation: The realm ladder is explained: Bitter Sea, Life Spring, Divine Bridge, Other Shore, forming the Wheel-and-Sea realm.

title: The Wheel of Life
summary: Elder Wu breaks up the fight and teaches the pair about the Wheel of Life below the navel, then instructs them in the Lingxu fragment of the Dao Scripture. In meditation, Pang Bo sees black seawater beneath a sheet of ice, while Ye Fan's Bitter Sea stays as hard as mystic iron; only the long-lost complete Dao Scripture might help him. Meanwhile, Han Feiyu tells his granduncle, Elder Han, that Ye Fan is a prime 'medicine catalyst' and is given the Green Wood Seal and Jade Tracking Pendant to capture him alive. To calm the restless Pang Bo, Elder Wu links him to the immortal crane with a Mutual Seal Technique, and Han Feiyu's group ambushes Ye Fan.
events: Elder Wu explains the Wheel of Life and teaches the Dao Scripture fragment
Pang Bo senses his Bitter Sea under ice; Ye Fan's cannot be opened
Elder Han orders Han Feiyu to capture Ye Fan alive, giving him two treasures
Elder Wu places a Mutual Seal Technique between Pang Bo and the crane
Han Feiyu and others ambush Ye Fan

title: Golden Tsunami
summary: Han Feiyu's group corners Ye Fan near a cliff, and Pang Bo, riding the immortal crane, clears his mind and breaks open his Bitter Sea. Using a 'Fist Cannon' learned from the crane, he and Ye Fan beat Han Feiyu's group, plant Han headfirst in the ground, and take over a hundred bottles of Hundred-Herb Liquid. Ye Fan explains the Bitter Sea through the ancient idea that each body is its own world. They drink heavily: Pang Bo's Bitter Sea doubles before he suffers backlash, and Ye Fan, after many bottles, finally sees a golden tsunami.
events: Pang Bo opens his Bitter Sea mid-fight with the crane's help
Pang Bo's 'Fist Cannon' routs Han Feiyu
They seize over a hundred bottles of Hundred-Herb Liquid
Ye Fan explains the body as a small world
Pang Bo suffers backlash from overdrinking; Ye Fan sees a golden tsunami
cultivation: Pang Bo opens his Bitter Sea and it doubles in size; Ye Fan's Bitter Sea finally stirs as a golden tsunami.

title: A Sesame-Sized Sea
summary: Ye Fan's newly opened Bitter Sea is golden, can manifest outside his body, and is only the size of a sesame seed, and he decides to keep it secret because Lingxu can't protect him from the Eastern Wasteland's powers. When Han Feiyu's gang attacks again, Pang Bo sends Han flying, and the Sect Leader punishes everyone with wall-facing at the rear mountain. Elder Wu explains the Han family's grip on Lingxu and that Elder Han, a medicine expert, is rumored to be at the Other Shore realm; he also describes the Ancient Wood Wolf Forest and how divine patterns are refined into weapons and artifacts. Ye Fan resolves to become strong on his own, while Elder Han tells Han Feiyu to wait until Ye Fan leaves Lingxu before striking.
events: Ye Fan hides his golden, sesame-sized Bitter Sea
Pang Bo and Ye Fan fight Han Feiyu's gang; all are punished
Elder Wu explains the Han family's power and Elder Han's standing
Elder Wu describes the Ancient Wood Wolf Forest and refining divine patterns into artifacts
Elder Han plans to seize Ye Fan once he leaves Lingxu
cultivation: Ye Fan's Bitter Sea is confirmed open: golden and able to manifest outside his body, but tiny.

title: Leaving Lingxu
summary: Pang Bo nearly shatters his Bitter Sea after secretly drinking more Hundred-Herb Liquid, and Elder Wu saves him while Ye Fan stands guard. Ye Fan studies the ancient scripture from the bronze coffin and senses force in every stroke, then decides to leave Lingxu and travel the Eastern Wasteland to seek his own opportunities. Han family lackeys fail to track him, but Pang Bo catches up, insisting they leave together. In the forest, rhythmic drumming, a Lightning Bird battling a giant ape, and a stampede of fleeing demon beasts force them to run, and circulating the Dao Scripture calms the pounding in their chests.
events: Elder Wu repairs Pang Bo's overloaded Bitter Sea
Ye Fan senses the power within the ancient scripture
Ye Fan leaves Lingxu Blessed Land; Pang Bo follows
A Lightning Bird fights a giant ape as demon beasts flee
A mysterious drumbeat is eased by the Dao Scripture

title: The Jade Serpent Orchid
summary: Ye Fan and Pang Bo spot a Jade Serpent Orchid guarded by a Jade-Horned Serpent and seize it during the drumbeat, which the serpent fears. Fleeing through a nest of the serpent's offspring, Pang Bo is poisoned and eats part of the orchid, and Ye Fan finishes the rest, expanding his Bitter Sea and manifesting divine patterns. Ye Fan tries to send Pang Bo back to Lingxu, but Pang Bo refuses to split up. Han Feiyu and Li Yun, who followed them into the forest, run into the serpent, and Elder Han arrives, eyeing the pair hungrily before they escape.
events: The pair steal the Jade Serpent Orchid while the serpent fears the drumbeat
The orchid cures Pang Bo's poisoning and strengthens both of them
Ye Fan manifests divine patterns
Pang Bo refuses to leave Ye Fan
Han Feiyu, Li Yun and Elder Han arrive; the serpent attacks and the pair escape
cultivation: Ye Fan's Bitter Sea expands again and he manifests divine patterns.

title: Tomb of the Demon Emperor
summary: Ye Fan and Pang Bo suspect Elder Han wants to use Ye Fan's Ancient Desolate Sacred Body for medicine, and wonder whether the drumbeat is the heartbeat of some ancient creature awakening. In a cold burial ground full of coffins, Pang Bo is possessed, and Ye Fan uses the Dao Scripture to pull him back. Sect Leader Li and Elder Wu of Lingxu Cave Heaven confront the demon race, who accuse the humans of coveting their clan's immortal treasury; the humans claim the last demon Great Emperor of the Eastern Wasteland stole humanity's supreme treasure and a key volume of the Dao Scripture. Battle breaks out, and Elder Wu orders Ye Fan to take Pang Bo and flee.
events: Ye Fan deduces Elder Han wants his body
They find a burial ground with overwhelming yin energy
Pang Bo is possessed; the Dao Scripture helps him resist
Lingxu and the demon race clash over the immortal treasury
Elder Wu tells Ye Fan to flee with Pang Bo
introduced: Demon Emperor (last demon Great Emperor of the Eastern Wasteland)

title: The Wheel-and-Sea Volume
summary: While demons chase them, Pang Bo is fully taken over and the demons congratulate their king on seizing his body. Elder Wu helps Ye Fan catch up, and Ye Fan recites lines of the Dao to reach his friend, but Pang Bo walks into the Demon Emperor's tomb anyway. Ye Fan finds a single golden page that seems to hold tens of thousands of characters: the Wheel-and-Sea Volume, the lost part of the Dao Scripture. He realizes Pang Bo left it for him on purpose and is still fighting the Demon King, and vows to save him.
events: Pang Bo is fully possessed by a Demon King
Lingxu forces break through demon defenders at the tomb door
Ye Fan pleads with Pang Bo using Dao scripture lines
Ye Fan obtains the Wheel-and-Sea Volume page
Ye Fan vows to save Pang Bo
cultivation: Ye Fan obtains the Wheel-and-Sea Volume of the Dao Scripture.

title: Two Families, One Seal
summary: The Ancient Desolate Ji family, led by Elder Ji, and the Ancient Desolate Jiang family arrive at the Demon Emperor's tomb, both after the Desolate Tower, one of three supreme treasures alongside Zhongzhou's Green Copper and Kunlun's Immortal Bell. They find the Dao Scripture already gone from the first layer of the sacred treasury and agree to break the Demon Emperor's Immortal-Slaying Power seal together. When the third layer opens, the Demon Emperor's heart escapes, and Pang Bo follows it. Ye Fan tracks Pang Bo by the heartbeat into an illusory formation of attacking vines, breaks its formation eye, and is met by a breathtakingly beautiful woman who warns him to stop.
events: The Ji and Jiang families arrive and compete for the Desolate Tower
The Dao Scripture is found missing from the first layer
The elders jointly break the Demon Emperor's seal
The Demon Emperor's heart escapes; Pang Bo follows it
Ye Fan breaks a formation and meets a mysterious woman

title: The Fated Daoist
summary: The woman, addressed as 'Your Highness', says Pang Bo gained a Demon King's power in a mortal body, and Ye Fan insists that whether to give himself up is Pang Bo's own choice. Her subordinate Qin Yao tests Ye Fan in close combat before Her Highness calls him off and takes Pang Bo with her. As the Ji and Jiang elders keep attacking the tomb, spiritual treasures fly out; Ye Fan catches a sentient demon weapon, only for a clumsy, tripping Daoist to 'subdue' it and walk off with it, and then do the same with a bead. The Daoist refuses to help exorcise Pang Bo but says a possessing demon must fulfill its host's wish and merge with their divine sense, which takes four or five years.
events: Her Highness debates Pang Bo's possession with Ye Fan
Qin Yao tests Ye Fan's strength
Pang Bo leaves with Her Highness
A Daoist twice takes treasures from Ye Fan
The Daoist explains that a demon needs four or five years to fully merge with its host
introduced: Her Highness (the woman in the formation)

title: Duan De and Scrap Copper
summary: The Daoist returns, introduces himself as Duan De, and camps by a stone wall that keeps drawing in treasures. It turns out to sit on a Treasure-Gathering Basin, which pulls out the Demon Emperor's sacred weapon. Yan Ruyu, princess of the demon race, claims it and escapes across the void with Pang Bo while the Ji and Jiang families give chase. A Jiang family member dismisses a copper fragment as scrap and leaves it to Ye Fan; Duan De then trades a lesson ('enlightenment is realizing it yourself') for the fragment, throws it away as rotten copper, and Ye Fan keeps it, sensing it is a hidden treasure.
events: The Daoist is named Duan De
A Treasure-Gathering Basin beneath the stone wall pulls out the Demon Emperor's sacred weapon
Yan Ruyu takes the weapon and leaves with Pang Bo
Ye Fan picks up a copper fragment the Jiang family dismissed
Duan De throws it away; Ye Fan keeps it

title: The Nether Pool
summary: Ye Fan finds natural Dao patterns on his copper shard, while Duan De, believing it fell into a pool, laments that it was Zhongzhou's supreme treasure, Green Copper. Duan De explains that the Demon Emperor built two tombs: a yang tomb in the volcano holding his heart and a yin tomb beneath the Nether Pool holding his true body. The pair escape a Black-Gold Ape and a three-headed guardian wielding extreme yin lightning and netherfire, the latter set off when Ye Fan throws the 'Nether Pool' tablet into the water. Duan De slaps down a Ji family disciple, and the bloodshed triggers the yin tomb's lethal kill-trap; when Ji elders arrive, Ye Fan pins the blame on Duan De, who is taken into the yin tomb while Ye Fan slips away.
events: Ye Fan discovers Dao patterns on the Green Copper shard
Duan De reveals the yang tomb and yin tomb
They escape a Black-Gold Ape and a three-headed tomb guardian
Duan De strikes a Ji family disciple, triggering the kill-trap
Ye Fan hands Duan De over to the Ji elders and leaves

title: Qingfeng Town Inn
summary: Ye Fan escapes the sealed ruins and arrives penniless at Old Jiang's run-down inn in Qingfeng Town, where Old Jiang and his granddaughter Tingting feed him and he repays them with a jade bottle. Using the Bodhi seed, he begins to understand the Wheel-and-Sea Volume and hopes to reach the Life Spring realm. He learns that the Li family's steward, Liu, bullies the old man because Old Jiang's son and daughter-in-law, who cultivated at Yanxia Cave Heaven, clashed with the Li family's young master before dying two years ago. Remembering his own family, Ye Fan secretly pits the Wang and Li families against each other to lure the Li heir, the Seventh Young Master, back, and learns about Source along the way.
events: Old Jiang and Tingting take Ye Fan in
Ye Fan studies the Wheel-and-Sea Volume with the Bodhi seed
Steward Liu of the Li family bullies the inn
Old Jiang tells how his son and daughter-in-law died
Ye Fan stirs up a Li-Wang feud; the Seventh Young Master returns
cultivation: Ye Fan's control over divine patterns sharpens as he begins the Wheel-and-Sea Volume.

title: A Cauldron and a Reckoning
summary: The Seventh Young Master claims Tingting's parents are dead and tries to take her to Yanxia Cave Heaven, and Ye Fan takes two of his blows while pretending to be a weak mortal. Ye Fan then shuts himself in a cave, condenses nineteen divine patterns in one day and night with the Wheel-and-Sea Volume, sets out to refine a three-legged cauldron, and finds that the golden scripture page itself can be used as a weapon. He confronts the Seventh Young Master, who admits he used a powder that drives spirit beasts berserk on Tingting's parents, leading to their deaths at a Lightning Bird's hands, before he dies. Ye Fan takes his Source, notices Jiang family cultivators searching the area, and tells Old Jiang the truth.
events: The Seventh Young Master tries to take Tingting
Ye Fan condenses nineteen divine patterns
The golden scripture page turns out to work as a weapon
The Seventh Young Master confesses and dies
Jiang family cultivators arrive in town; Ye Fan tells Old Jiang the truth
cultivation: Ye Fan condenses nineteen divine patterns and wields the golden page as a weapon.

title: Hunted Across Yan
summary: The Jiang cultivators reveal that Old Jiang's late father, Jiang Zhe, belonged to the Ancient Desolate Jiang family, and they take Old Jiang and Tingting home to the clan. Ye Fan declines to join them, citing his promise to return home with a friend, and tells Tingting to rely on herself. He is soon hunted by a Divine Bridge-level pursuer and flees near the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land, where the ancient scripture heals his wounds. Two peak Bitter Sea cultivators whose young master's spirit beast can sense treasure corner him; Ye Fan lures one close with the Source and kills them, then disappears into a crowded market while wondering whether the Jiang woman sent them.
events: Old Jiang is revealed to be Jiang Zhe's son and joins the Jiang family
Ye Fan turns down the offer to travel with them
A Divine Bridge-realm pursuer hunts Ye Fan
The ancient scripture heals his wounds
Ye Fan kills two Bitter Sea cultivators and hides in a crowd
cultivation: The ancient scripture is shown to heal wounds.

title: Old Friends, Old Enemies
summary: Disguised as a beggar, Ye Fan runs into Li Xiaoman, now a cultivator with youth restored, and her Senior Brother and Senior Sister, who sense his Source. Xiaoman urges him to sell it and accept life as a mortal, since his constitution can't cultivate, and Ye Fan refuses and quietly parts ways with her. He glimpses a spring forming in his Bitter Sea, the start of the Life Spring, then kills three Bitter Sea cultivators who hunt him for the Source and hides it. Elder Han then finds him more than a thousand li from Lingxu, reveals he had marked Ye Fan earlier, and captures him to use as the main ingredient in his medicine.
events: Ye Fan meets Li Xiaoman and her fellow disciples
Xiaoman urges him to trade his Source; he refuses
Ye Fan glimpses a Life Spring in his Bitter Sea
He kills three cultivators and hides the Source
Elder Han captures Ye Fan

Xiaoman's Senior Brother and Senior Sister
cultivation: Ye Fan's Bitter Sea shows the first sign of a Life Spring.

title: Into the Cauldron
summary: A Jiang family fighter tries to take Ye Fan from Elder Han, but Han escapes with his captive at the cost of nearly losing a hand. In a cave abode sealed off by Dao patterns, Han reveals he wants to devour Ye Fan's Ancient Desolate Sacred Body to break through the Wheel-and-Sea realm, refining it along with Ebony Divine Lotus seeds, Green Jade Snow Lotus fruit and Nine-Leaf Phoenix Grass. Ye Fan is sealed in a cauldron of Hundred-Herb slurry, facing seven days of torment. Close to despair, he sees visions of his friends, resolves to live and save Pang Bo, and recites the Way of Heaven scripture.
events: A Jiang family fighter battles Elder Han
Elder Han reveals his spirit herbs and plan
Ye Fan is put in a medicinal cauldron for seven days
Visions of his friends restore Ye Fan's will to live
Ye Fan recites the ancient scripture inside the cauldron
cultivation: Elder Han says devouring the Ancient Desolate Sacred Body would let him break through the Wheel-and-Sea realm.

title: Life Spring and Dandelions
summary: Soaking up the spirit herbs' medicine inside the cauldron, Ye Fan regains movement while Elder Han, mistaking the signs for a top-grade pill forming, keeps refining for a full seven days. When Han opens the cauldron, Ye Fan unleashes a sneak-attack killing blow he had held back for seven days, and Han dies refusing to accept it. Ye Fan uses Han's hidden cave abode to evade the Jiang family, and after a year and five failed attempts he breaks through to the Life Spring realm, though his flight is still unstable. During a Moon Festival in the city, he buys buns for a hungry beggar girl, Nannan, and watching dandelions teaches him how yin and yang create momentum, so he flies with her into the sky.
events: Ye Fan absorbs the cauldron's medicine and recovers
Ye Fan kills Elder Han with a surprise blow
A year of seclusion in Han's cave abode
Ye Fan breaks through to the Life Spring realm
Ye Fan learns to fly by watching dandelions and flies with Nannan
cultivation: Ye Fan breaks through to the Life Spring realm and masters flight through insight into yin-yang momentum.
